positive_snippets:
The washroom and room were maintained to a high standard of cleanliness.

The room service provided was excellent.

Good place to stay for 1-2 nights. Cost effective place and clean. We booked a bigger room because we were 3 people and they provide extra bed as well.

You can order food from outside and they will provide the cutlery.

I stayed at Treebo Grand Town House for 2 nights. It is near and clean. The bed linen was fresh. The hotel has a simple vibe but they maintain good cleanliness and hygiene. The staff is friendly, corporative and helpful. They are to well versed in their job and seem to be cheerful. It was a great experience staying here.
Highly Recommended!

Sorry no photos to share. Writing this review was an after thought.
